newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura shareholder meet lasts over 3 hrs.
newsitem.headline: Nomura shareholder meet lasts over 3 hrs.

text.p: Nomura Securities Co Ltd's annual shareholders' meeting on Friday lasted more than three hours, making it the longest such event in recent years, a company spokeswoman said.
The meeting began at 10 a.m. (0100 GMT) and finished at 1.19 p.m. (0419 GMT), the spokeswoman said.
The spokeswoman said the meeting was easily the longest since the company began keeping track of the length of its annual briefing of shareholders in 1990.
The previous longest meetings were in 1991 and 1992, when discussions lasted one hour and 25 minutes, she said.
This year's meeting was being closely followed in light of the scandal at Nomura over payoffs to racketeers.
Nomura posted a summary of the proceedings on the Internet in a bid to improve transparency in the wake of the scandal.
